blocks.x: All right. Well I appreciate your making it tonight.
It was a pleasure talking to you about the little things. I keep thinking I missed a lot of things, but you got a smattering of— © Fillius Jazz Archive -21-
And if we come back out maybe we’ll pick up on the things that we missed the first time.
Good, good, and say I don’t know if you need this supplemental material but of course you can have this one and the picture.
